description: Per-jurisdiction Council Lv7+ unanimity activation Lexicon per ADR-2605282200 G14 — gates which sender↔recipient jurisdiction pairs are eligible for kawase-yui send/receive. Each activation is a CONSTITUTIONAL act requiring all 5 Council seats to sign the legalAnalysisCid (= chigiri.ipLicenseClaim or commentary chain establishing money-services-business non-applicability, securities-law non-applicability, AML/CFT non-applicability for that jurisdiction). Founding R1 jurisdictions = US + JP (Founder seat 1 covers both). EU + UK + KR + CH unlock as Council Seats 2-5 close (RFP open until 2026-06-19).

jurisdiction.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g. USA / JPN / DEU / FRA / KOR / GBR / CHE).

activatedFor.description: Direction of activation. `both` requires the same legal analysis to cover both sender and recipient legs.

legalAnalysisCid.description: CID of the chigiri.ipLicenseClaim record (or equivalent legal analysis Lexicon) establishing the four non-applicabilities: (1) money-services-business license non-applicability under §1.12 routing-around + mutual-aid framing; (2) securities-law non-applicability (no token sale, mid-market only); (3) AML/CFT non-applicability under SBT-KYC + Charter §1.12; (4) tax-reporting position (typically: adherent-to-adherent personal mutual aid = recipient-side income reporting only).

councilAttestations.description: DIDs of ALL 5 Council seats (Founder + 4 Bootstrap Council Seats 2-5). Council Lv7+ unanimity is a constitutional invariant per ADR-2605192300 + ADR-2605282200 G14.

supersedes.description: Optional CID of a previous jurisdictionAttestation for the same (jurisdiction, activatedFor) pair that this one replaces. Used when legal analysis updates (e.g., new regulator guidance) without re-doing the Council Lv7+ ceremony from scratch — supersession still requires Lv7+ unanimity.
